prompt: A compound C₃H₆O₂ shows the IR below. The C=O appears at ~1735, and there's a strong band in the 1000-1300 range. No broad O-H. Identify the structure.

options.label: Methyl formate / methyl acetate (ester, C=O ~1735 + C-O 1000-1300)
Propanoic acid (would show very broad O-H 2500-3300)
Glycerol monoester (would show broad O-H + ester C=O)

explanation: C=O at 1735 cm⁻¹ is ester-range (acids are 1710, ketones 1715, aldehydes 1725, esters 1735). Strong C-O stretch at 1000-1300 confirms ester (the C-O-C of the ester linkage). Absence of broad O-H rules out COOH, alcohols. Methyl acetate fits C₃H₆O₂.
